ariaSheetHandle: Drag to lower or raise the panel
tipResetStyles: Restores this CV's original look (font, sizes, colours, spacing, palette and format). Your text is NOT touched.
tipResetAll: Deletes your edited text and styles, and reloads the original template. Your saved CVs are not touched.
dlgResetAllMsg:
Your edited text and saved styles will be discarded: this CV will go back to the original template and the page will reload.

Your saved CVs are NOT touched. If you only want to undo the look, use “Reset styles”.
noteTextMobileLimited:
Limited on mobile: to edit the CV text,
use the desktop version.
